correctness.rationale: In characteristic two reversing each long permutation cycle cancels its determinant contribution, so adjacency char polynomial equals matching polynomial; deleting the chord and endpoints gives χ_{H_n}=X² f_{n−2}. The path recurrence f_m=Xf_{m−1}+f_{m−2} and doubling identities show zero algebraic multiplicity 2 for even n and z=2^{ν₂(n−1)}+1 for odd n. Independently solving Ax=0 along the path between chord endpoints gives nullity 2/even, 1/odd, forcing the zero-primary Jordan block partition. Fitting decomposition makes first-periodic entry identical to nilpotent-component height, yielding exactly q^{n−z} at T0 and (q−1)q^{n−z+t−1} at t≥1 (or even-n T1=(q²−1)q^{n−2}). At n=2^a+1 z=n, so full operator nilpotent. Independent GF2 power-kernel checks across 574 t,n pairs corroborate, not prove the all-n/F2^b result.
